sources.entry: Superset - Modern data exploration and visualization platform. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Python
Apache Superset | Data visualisation and data exploration platform

summary.one_liner: Apache Superset is a web-based, enterprise-ready business intelligence and data exploration and visualization platform.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Superset as a modern data exploration and visualization platform that can replace or augment proprietary BI tools. It offers a no-code chart builder, a web-based SQL Editor for advanced querying, and a lightweight semantic layer for defining custom dimensions and metrics. It provides a range of visualizations from simple bar charts to geospatial views, plus dashboards. It includes a configurable caching layer, role-based security with extensible authentication, and an API for programmatic customization. It can query any SQL-speaking datastore that has a Python DB-API driver and a SQLAlchemy dialect, with Presto, Trino and Athena named as examples.
use_cases: run ad-hoc SQL queries in a browser
visualize data from multiple SQL databases
how_to_run: Try the quickstart guide referenced in the README (Superset in 2 Minutes using Docker Compose)
Official Docker image (see Deploying Superset docs)
Helm Chart for Kubernetes deployment (see Deploying Superset docs)
Install database drivers per the Installing Database Drivers guide
notable: No-code chart builder plus a full web SQL Editor in one app
Lightweight semantic layer for custom dimensions and metrics
Works with any SQL database that has a Python DB-API driver and SQLAlchemy dialect
Extensible visualization plugins built on ECharts
Official Docker image and Helm chart for deployment
caveats: Installation and production setup require configuration; the README links to separate admin guides rather than detailing them
Database support depends on installing the appropriate Python drivers for each datastore
